Messages.Body:
The answer to this one seems obvious to me ("Yes, because it
isn't an action"), but I would like confirmation:

Cybele is an anarch. I have a Path of Evil Revelations in play.

During my master phase, Cybele is untapped.
I play Piper, and tap her to bring out a Herald of Topheth.
Then I pay a pool to use the Path of Evil Revelations to untap
Cybele.
(By her special ability, I have a second MPA)
I play a second Piper, tapping her again to bring out a second
Herald of Topheth.

Legal?

(And then, during the minion phase, I can untap her with Rutor's
Hand and take an actual recruit-Herald action, of course)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> The answer to this one seems obvious to me ("Yes, because it
> isn't an action"), but I would like confirmation:
>
> Cybele is an anarch. I have a Path of Evil Revelations in play.
>
> During my master phase, Cybele is untapped.
> I play Piper, and tap her to bring out a Herald of Topheth.
> Then I pay a pool to use the Path of Evil Revelations to untap
> Cybele.
> (By her special ability, I have a second MPA)
> I play a second Piper, tapping her again to bring out a second
> Herald of Topheth.
>
> Legal?

Yes.

The simple version of the question is: I play Piper to have VampireA get an
ally. Then I untap vampireA somehow (Alexandra, Path of Evil Revelations,
whatever) and use a second master phase action to play another Piper. Can that
piper be used to have vampireA recruit another copy of that same ally?

The answer is yes.

> (And then, during the minion phase, I can untap her with Rutor's
> Hand and take an actual recruit-Herald action, of course)

And if vampireA untaps again, he or she can recruit another copy of that same
ally again with the normal recruit action, yes.

Hehe :)

The heralds are good in theory, they have an awesome range of
disciplines at their disposal and they got a big fist, a bleed. 5 life
+ regeneration is *great* to boot. The ability for them to jump
someone and disarm them at will is awesome.

But the friggin' upkeep on them is too much imo. Compare them to War
Ghouls or Shamblers additional cost and they are more "fair" than the
heralds, easier to side step. I've tried several variants of bloat to
cover for the heralds but all seemed risky, any serious threat blew me
off the table anyway :( The deck I had most success with was a variant
of Peter Bakija's My Deck is cooler than yours (http://thelasombra.com/
decks/twd.htm#2k4cooler) that I shoe horned some heralds into, with a
small combat package to support them (I belive it was 3 conflag and
2-3 disarms), but it always felt like I shot myself in the foot for
playing the demons.

Oh well, nagging me :P
